documents.title: Critical edition introduction
documents.text:
Critical edition introduction — Varro Glosses (fictional).
In this document "VG-MS" means Varro Glosses. Varro AB reports number of scribal hands of 2 for FY2024. Varro Glosses reports approximately witness count of 49 for FY2024. Varro Glosses reports folio count of 159 for FY2025. Varro Glosses reports recorded variant readings of 1496 for FY2024 on a reported basis. For Varro Glosses, the reading of the colophon is read as: names the scribe as a monk of the house.
